name: kegg-flow-bubble-plot
description: Generate publication-ready KEGG gene-pathway flow-bubble plots.

interface.shortDescription: 绘制基因-通路带状连接与KEGG富集气泡组合图
interface.longDescription: 从KEGG富集结果表生成节点高度与连接数量严格对应、交叉区域透明叠加变深、并带对齐气泡图的论文级组合图。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $kegg-flow-bubble-plot to create a publication-ready KEGG flow-bubble plot from my enrichment results.
